answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 37371 Country: Bangladesh Title: I work in a company and sometime I print lots of pages for my own (personal) work or other income Question: I work in a company and sometime I print lots of pages for my own (personal) work or other income. For example, if I print 100 pages then I give my office 200 pages for print cost. But nobody knows that. Always I need this print because I have no printer and printer is very costly for me. I pay for this print. Is my other income lawful? Answer ID: 37371 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 402/323/B=1433) There is no harm in it. Your income is halal and lawful. Note: If the owner of the company allows the same directly and clearly then the said ruling is alright. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
